title: File watcher falsely marks every session dirty and repeatedly defers persistence
outcome: Greg reports repeated persist snapshot still deferred after bounded retry for all1378 sessions. src/sse_broadcast.rs record_active_turn_file_changes calls session_mut_by_index before eligibility and scope checks; this eagerly advances mutation_stamp on every session for every nonempty file-change event, including idle, hidden, remote and unrelated sessions. The persist planner rejects candidates when the stamp changes between selection and per-record materialization. Fix read-before-mutate, preserve actual active/grace file-change behavior and runtime-only grace expiry, and prove irrelevant file events leave persistence candidates stable. Separate from workspace404 and possible browser connection starvation; do not claim this alone fixes them.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The watcher scan no longer stamps sessions (src/sse_broadcast.rs:578-584; reviewed at 4dec5eb). Closed by evidence.
